## Setup
1. Sa 3 MySQL node dito, piliin sa Credential dropdown ang EXISTING "MySQL account" credential mo (parehong cafe_brewm database).
2. Activate.
3. I-copy ang webhook URLs (clock-in, clock-out, list) sa src/PosApp.jsx at src/LedgerDashboard.jsx.

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO shifts (staff_name, time_in_ts, day_in, date_in, time_in, status) VALUES ('{{$json.StaffName.replace(/'/g, "''")}}', '{{$json.Ts}}', '{{$json.Day}}', '{{$json.Date}}', '{{$json.Time}}', 'active')

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "success": true, "staffName": $('Format Clock In').item.json.StaffName, "day": $('Format Clock In').item.json.Day, "date": $('Format Clock In').item.json.Date, "time": $('Format Clock In').item.json.Time } }}

parameters.query: =UPDATE shifts SET time_out_ts = '{{$json.Ts}}', day_out = '{{$json.Day}}', date_out = '{{$json.Date}}', time_out = '{{$json.Time}}', status = 'closed' WHERE staff_name = '{{$json.StaffName.replace(/'/g, "''")}}' AND status = 'active' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "success": true, "staffName": $('Format Clock Out').item.json.StaffName, "day": $('Format Clock Out').item.json.Day, "date": $('Format Clock Out').item.json.Date, "time": $('Format Clock Out').item.json.Time } }}

parameters.query: SELECT s.id, s.staff_name, s.day_in, s.date_in, s.time_in, s.day_out, s.date_out, s.time_out, s.status, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.staff = s.staff_name AND o.created_at >= s.time_in_ts AND o.created_at <= COALESCE(s.time_out_ts, NOW())), 0) AS order_count, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o WHERE o.staff = s.staff_name AND o.created_at >= s.time_in_ts AND o.created_at <= COALESCE(s.time_out_ts, NOW())), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(o.profit) FROM orders o WHERE o.staff = s.staff_name AND o.created_at >= s.time_in_ts AND o.created_at <= COALESCE(s.time_out_ts, NOW())), 0) AS total_profit FROM shifts s ORDER BY s.id DESC
